name: Bright Moon, Lantern Glow
description: The people in Liyue Harbor are celebrating Lantern Rite, and a Ministry of Civil Affairs employee named Pingxi seems to be responsible for welcoming visitors...

dialogs.content: The arrangements this year came together pretty nicely. Phew... At least I don't have to trouble Lady Keqing to come and review personally.
Ugh! I've got to stop dwelling on these things! I'm the God of Fortune I'm the God of Fortune I'm the God of Fortune...
And you are...?
I'm the God of Fortune!
I... I can tell...
#Huh? Isn't this {NICKNAME}? Goodness, if I'd known you were the one coming, I wouldn't have to memorize so many lines...
And given the looks of you, I presume that you are here to celebrate Lantern Rite?
It's about time you showed up! Look around — it's even more lively than last year's Lantern Rite, isn't it?
Every Lantern Rite...
Of course! You know what they say, "Xiao Lanterns soar and fill the night, step by step we seek new heights!" We've gotta improve in everything we do.
Aiya, let's not dwell on that during the festivities. Come come, let me show you where the fun happens.
Let me think... Hm... Got it! First things first — you have to release Xiao Lanterns. It's Lantern Rite after all.
And then, we also set up a bunch of Auspicious Treasure Trees around Liyue Harbor. As long as you prune their branches properly, the Fortune Coins inside are yours.
How many trees did we put out again...? Was it 21? Yes, 21 trees.
Actually, there's an Auspicious Treasure Tree not too far away! If you're interested, you can help to prune it. Don't worry, it's very simple.
And finally, you can also check out the Bulletin Board. It's right beside me.
Many tourists from other nations have joined us for Lantern Rite in the recent years, so the Ministry of Civil Affairs prepared a special Bulletin Board for them.
Whatever issues they run into, or if there's anything they need help with, they can write it down and post it on the Bulletin Board.
We at the Ministry of Civil Affairs will make sure everyone who comes to Liyue for Lantern Rite leaves with a smile, hehe!
That's the Ministry of Civil Affairs for you.
Of course!
#By the way, {NICKNAME}, I remember you're really good at taking pictures, aren't you?
I know a little.
Hahaha, don't be so modest. I just wanted to... ask you for a little favor.
It's really simple, I promise! All you have to do is take a commemorative photo for some tourists.

We originally hired a few photographers to take commemorative photos for everyone, but we didn't expect that there would be so many tourists this year. There suddenly weren't enough photographers to go around.
#It's too late to hire new photographers... You're the only one I can count on, {NICKNAME}!
Please! For the tourists, for Lantern Rite, for Liyue! You're the only one who can help us!
Leave it to me!
#You're a lifesaver, {NICKNAME}! I'll tell you the tourists' names and their designated locations right away.
I'm counting on you! With your help, this year's Lantern Rite will be flawless.
Here, these Xiao Lanterns are for you! Hehe, Happy Lantern Rite!
For Lantern Rite!
Nope, I'm a complete rookie.
That's Liyue for you...
Feels more impressive than the year before...
That's a very auspicious outfit...
